messages:
AcmeCorp-SRE: Hey team — we accidentally applied a 7-day retention on production logs for org acme-corp (org_98765). Can you confirm if there's any way to backfill or stop deletions? We have customers asking for archived audit logs.

maya-support: Sorry to hear that. Quick Qs: do you have a request_id from the deletion job or the dashboard action? Also confirm whether you used customer-managed KMS key or Redwood-managed.

AcmeCorp-SRE: Request id is req_20260317_44a1, timestamp ~2026-03-17T14:02:13Z. We are using a CMK (key_id: cmk-0a1b2c). We tried GET /v1/audit-logs and got 410 Gone for some objects. Example response: {\"error\":\"object_deleted\",\"code\":410,\"message\":\"Data expired per retention policy\"}

leo-security: If the CMK is scheduled for rotation or deletion that matters — if the key itself was deleted then ciphertext can't be decrypted for re-encryption. Don't rotate/delete the key until we confirm. :eyes:

rs-infra: Can you paste the exact API call you ran and the full response headers? Also tell us the time range (UTC) for the logs you need to recover. I can look up the purge job in our retention service logs.

AcmeCorp-SRE: API call used: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx" \
  "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/audit-logs?org=org_98765&start=2026-03-08T00:00:00Z&end=2026-03-15T23:59:59Z"
```
Response snippet: 
```json
{\"items\":[],\"deleted\": [\"log_2026-03-09_ae34\"], \"error\": {\"code\":410, \"message\": \"Data expired per retention policy\"}}
```
We need logs from 2026-03-09 to support an audit.

maya-support: Thanks. I'm putting a temporary retention hold on org_98765 while we investigate. I need written confirmation from your side to proceed (legal/POA). If you confirm, we'll pause the deletion queue and open an internal incident.

natalie-legal: For legal hold we need (1) org owner confirmation, (2) case id and reason. Hold can be applied immediately but it's not a restore. If the objects are already garbage-collected, we can't guarantee recovery. Please confirm you authorize a hold for 72 hours to give infra time to inspect.

AcmeCorp-SRE: Confirmed by org owner (email owner@acme.com). Authorize 72-hour hold. Case: ACME-AUDIT-20260317. Please escalate — this is blocker for compliance.

maya-support: Hold applied. retention-bot: \"Retention hold applied for org_98765 by maya-support until 2026-03-20T14:45:00Z (72h). Internal incident INC-2026-789 created.\"

retention-bot: Retention hold event logged: {"org":"org_98765","hold_id":"hold_20260317_01","expires_at":"2026-03-20T14:45:00Z","applied_by":"maya-support"}

rs-infra: I'm pulling the purge worker logs now. Can you run this quick query to give me the exact object ids you saw missing?
```bash
# run in your environment to capture headers we need
curl -I "https://api.redwood.inference/v1/audit-logs?org=org_98765&start=2026-03-09T00:00:00Z&end=2026-03-10T00:00:00Z" -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx"
```
We need the x-amz-request-id from the response headers if present, or the full response body.

AcmeCorp-SRE: Got headers: x-amz-request-id: 3E7F91D2, x-redwood-request: req_20260317_44a1. Missing objects list: ["log_2026-03-09_ae34","log_2026-03-09_bf55"]. Sending owner confirmation to legal channel.

leo-security: I'll check CMK state. If the key is Enabled we may be able to rehydrate from cold backups and re-encrypt. If key is PendingDeletion or Disabled we need to stop and coordinate with KMS team.

rs-infra: Found purge job entry: 
```
2026-03-17T14:02:11Z purge_worker org=org_98765 job=req_20260317_44a1 deleted=[log_2026-03-09_ae34] status=completed
```
Looks like GC ran ~2s before your GET. I'll try to see if archived cold snapshots exist for those object ids; if so we can run a backfill restore to hot for you. This may take ~4-24 hours.

maya-support: Next steps we're taking: 1) Hold applied, 2) Infra is checking cold snapshots & KMS state, 3) Security will confirm CMK status, 4) Legal has POA. We'll update INC-2026-789 and ping once we know if a backfill is possible.

AcmeCorp-SRE: Appreciate the fast response. One ask: if backfill is possible, can you also provide audit trail (who/when retention changed to 7d) for our internal RCA?

natalie-legal: We can provide the retention change log once it's pulled. Note: retention change events are preserved in audit-logs and will be included if available.

leo-security: CMK status: Enabled, not scheduled for deletion. Good sign. Moving to KMS team to authorize limited decrypt for the restore process.

rs-infra: Update: found a cold snapshot from 2026-03-10 that contains the missing objects but they are encrypted with cmk-0a1b2c. Since key is Enabled we can attempt decrypt/re-encrypt during restore. ETA initial attempt 6 hours.

maya-support: Thanks all. I'll keep ACME updated in-thread. Assigning follow-ups to infra (rs-infra) and security (leo-security).

AcmeCorp-SRE: Thanks everyone. Will wait for the restore update.

retention-bot: Incident INC-2026-789 status: investigation_in_progress. Assigned_to: rs-infra, leo-security, maya-support.

maya-support: Quick note for the customer: if you attempt any retention API changes while we investigate please ping here so we can coordinate — changes during restore can complicate things. :bow:
